# Friday small groups {.unnumbered}

[One hour every Friday, best effort, in one of four time slots · open discussion, led by you]{.subtitle .lead}

Friday is an open discussion. You bring the topics: something AI helped you
learn this week, something you caught it getting wrong, a question from a
chapter or a talk, or a situation you saw on a rotation. Talking about AI with
an attending, a colleague, a patient, or an interviewer is a skill, and it gets
better when you practise it out loud. The groups are not recorded, so you can
try ideas and get them wrong.

Leave out anything that could identify a patient (see [the patient information
page](patient-information.qmd)).

**Week 4 (November 6).** The last group is for your five-minute "what you will
keep" presentations from the [learning journal](learning-journal.qmd).
